items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: And at that time the band was named by him, Alexander Right Time Band. And after he got droned, then the way Cromont player and myself, we called it Lawrence and Dewey Arbster. So we played... we played together.

ctx.x: Dajon, Alexander. And at that time the band was named by him, Alexander Right Time Band. And after he got droned, then the way Cromont player and myself, we called it Lawrence and Dewey Arbster. So we played, well I don't remember how many years we played together. And he left the country, so we had another boy to play in his place. And we keep switching off, get some new mans until, then we, until this boy came in with us, Herbert Hall.
